huggingface.rights_evidence: https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/en/api and https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/en/rate-limits document open public /api/models and anonymous API access; narrowly admitted metadata-only local research/discovery, attached licenses/gating separate; no weights, private repos, pricing/performance/credit inference or raw public redistribution admission; reviewed 2026-10-14
huggingface.attribution: Hugging Face public Hub API; model-card license tags are discovery metadata, not model-use permission

azure.rights_evidence: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/cost-management/retail-prices/azure-retail-prices explicitly documents unauthenticated own tools for internal analysis and region/SKU price comparison; internal local use only, no public raw-feed redistribution admission; reviewed 2026-10-14
azure.attribution: Microsoft Azure Retail Prices API; undiscounted native USD VM list meters, not capacity offers

ecb.rights_evidence: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/services/using-our-site/disclaimer/html/index.en.html permits free accurate information reuse with ECB attribution, free-availability notice in sold documents and derived-modification disclosure; https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html links latest daily XML; reviewed 2026-10-14
ecb.attribution: European Central Bank, euro foreign exchange reference rates; free from https://www.ecb.europa.eu; informational only, not transaction rates

scaleway.rights_evidence: Public catalog API documents unauthenticated access, but https://www.scaleway.com/en/legal-notice/ and current service intellectual-property terms do not establish persisted commercial benchmark/display/redistribution rights

getdeploying.rights_evidence: https://getdeploying.com/dataset/gpu-prices (published dataset files only; CC BY 4.0; reviewed 2026-10-14)
getdeploying.attribution: GetDeploying, GPU rental price history, https://getdeploying.com/gpus, CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

openrouter.rights_evidence: https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/models documents freely available no-auth Models API metadata and production integrations, including pagination/current-default pricing; narrow intended documented API integration for local catalog cost comparison only. https://openrouter.ai/terms (2026-08-31), sections 7(4), 7(5), and 12 restrict access resale/competing services/automated copying/materials; general automation ambiguity remains, no website scraping, broad archival/raw public redistribution, Model API access resale, prompts, inference, provider-endpoint queries, routing or broker execution admitted; independent legal review required before commercial resale or broader archive use; reviewed 2026-10-14
openrouter.attribution: OpenRouter public Models API; advertised USD rates under current default conditions, no provider-pinned or future workload quote

aws_public_pricing.rights_evidence: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/price-changes.html expressly supports cost control/scenario planning/budget forecasting and AWS cost comparison; https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/using-the-aws-price-list-bulk-api-fetching-price-list-files-manually.html documents published regional price-file downloads; narrow local AWS cost-comparison admission, no raw public redistribution or resale license; https://aws.amazon.com/terms/ and https://aws.amazon.com/agreement/ restrictions retained; reviewed 2026-10-14
aws_public_pricing.attribution: Amazon Web Services published price list; informational native AWS meters for local cost comparison, service pricing pages control actual charges

aws_ec2.rights_evidence: Public regional EC2 price files may exceed bounded retrieval limits; authenticated scoped Price List Query API requires IAM credentials, not admitted by public-only collection.

oracle.rights_evidence: https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Billing/Tasks/signingup_topic-Estimating_Costs.htm documents public partNumber/currencyCode list-price access; https://www.oracle.com/legal/terms/ limits Materials to personal informational noncommercial use and automated means absent specific written permission; commercial retention/benchmark scope remains pending.

ovhcloud.rights_evidence: Public price pages and catalog discovery do not establish intended data retention/reuse rights here; current Oct 1 2026 pricing separates instance/local-storage/public-IPv4 components; documented public-catalog semantics and scope require review.
